purpose: Preserve UberBond's long-horizon product dream, named program lineage, portfolio breadth, strategic ladders, contradictions and unresolved owner-recalled names across chat/model/context resets without promoting historical or synthetic material into current truth.
truthRule: Current repository code, exact-head executable receipts, and durable external provider/customer evidence outrank this historical memory index. This index prevents forgetting; it does not manufacture present-tense capability, demand, payment, acceptance, legality, provider state, or unattended-operation proof.

finalGoal.economicNorthStar: Maximize risk-adjusted cleared contribution profit per founder minute.
finalGoal.endState: A private, cloud-runnable, globally distributed, evidence-first economic operating system that can lawfully discover opportunities, select and compose offers, acquire distribution, execute bounded work, collect and reconcile payment, prove delivery and customer acceptance, renew/expand, learn from verified outcomes, acquire missing capabilities, and increasingly operate without founder attention.
finalGoal.portfolioLaw: Many front-end offers and experiments may exist, but they must compose from one shared governed operating system rather than becoming disconnected businesses or duplicate SaaS clones.
finalGoal.distributionGoal: World-class multi-channel distribution using partners/white-label, governed direct outbound, referrals, product-led diagnostics, owned content/SEO/AEO, social/public distribution, communities/directories, marketplaces and agent/API surfaces, with paid media only after measured positive economics.
finalGoal.cloudGoal: Run from durable cloud infrastructure with restart-safe scheduling, receipts, provider adapters, health, recovery, auditability and founder-absence evidence rather than dependence on one chat or device.
finalGoal.wealthGoalBoundary: Massive wealth is an ambition, not a repository fact or forecast. Progress is earned through real cleared contribution, accepted delivery, recurrence, partner leverage, defensible learning and founder-light operation.

antiForgettingRules: Never reduce UberBond to the currently active commercial experiment. The experiment is one validation path inside a much larger portfolio.
Never treat historical offer/combinations counts as customers, active SKUs, revenue or proof of demand.
Never delete a named historical initiative from memory merely because its branch or implementation is superseded; mark its reconciliation status instead.
Never resurrect a superseded architecture wholesale when current main already contains its useful semantics.
Never treat OMNIA synthetic scale/test counts as production, economic or market proof.
Never let a new chat infer that an unmentioned feature or program never existed; search the memory index, historical lineage and source registry first.
Owner-recalled but currently unverified names must remain visible as unresolved memory rather than being guessed or silently dropped.

Every new material chat/export/share should be digested into repository-native memory with provenance, date, authority class, decisions, contradictions and supersession links; a share URL alone is not durable memory.
Current repository and durable external receipts always outrank historical memory when they conflict.
